But placeholders are just empty question marks in boxes, no detailed content. The geometry is mostly boxes/arrows. The relation "not all at once" is captured by staging. But the image's text only labels stages; no explanation of causality. It could help scaffold board. Yet "state-strip" with empty ? placeholders. meta? No, ? slots not meta. leak? No, empty. It might distract but not harmful. Usefulness 2? Geometry 2? Verdict keep/fix? Worst issue: three subsequent frames are all "？" and not related, may dilute; or title "怎么落地" but no content.
